title: Elliott Component (manifest.yaml)
description: Manifest for an elliott/v1 component (tool, gateway, extension, mcp-endpoint, scheduler, …).

apiVersion.description: Manifest API version. Only elliott/v1 is understood by the loader.

profile.description: Security/interaction profile name, e.g. gateway-standard, tool-standard, tool-local-only, extension-standard.

class.description: Egress posture. Mirrors src/placement/types.ts EgressClassName exactly — every class the runtime can realize must be declarable here. `declared` requires an explicit `hosts` allowlist; `loopback` is real network egress confined to the runtime's own HTTP port (e.g. a facility provider that forwards to an internal route).

hosts.description: Allowlisted egress hosts (used with class: declared).

capability.description: Capability name, e.g. network.connect, secret.use, fs.read, fs.write, process.execute.

deferred.description: JIT operator approval on first use.

ref.description: Exported component ref, e.g. gateway/slack, tool/files.

implementation.description: Path to the implementation module, relative to the component root.

facility.description: Facility id this component provides to other components, e.g. proxy.route, ingress.webhook, dns.local. See src/runtime/skills/facilities.ts.

version.description: Facility contract version. A consumer's cached binding is invalidated when this changes.

document.description: Human-facing document filename, e.g. TOOL.md, GATEWAY.md, EXTENSION.md, MCP.md, SCHEDULER.md, EVALUATOR.md.

provides.description: Facilities this component provides to other components. The two-pass loader registers every provider before any consumer.

isolation.description: Requested isolation level. See src/core/types.ts IsolationLevel.

topology.description: Optional connection-graph metadata consumed by scripts/gen-topology.mjs to place this component in docs/elliott-topology.json. Ignored by the runtime loader (bundled.ts reads only document/protocols/exports).

node.description: The connection-graph node this component contributes. Omit only if the component contributes no node.

id.description: Graph node id, e.g. tool.files, gateway.slack, service.scheduler.

kind.description: Graph node kind (the authoritative role, which may differ from the manifest `kind`: e.g. gateway-gmail declares kind:gateway but contributes a tool node). Mirrors NODE_KINDS in scripts/gen-topology.mjs exactly — that script is the actual consumer of this field.

domain.description: Architectural domain id (ingress, agent-core, tool-execution, external-integrations, mcp-federation, self-evolution, observability, …).

dispatch.description: How the runtime reaches this node; drives the auto-derived edge. socket: gateway→inbound. route: http→node + node→inbound. tool: toolExec→node. service/none: no auto edge (declare via `edges`).

gate.description: Liveness gate that sets the node `runtime` flag: 'always' (live), a settings key like 'settings.slack' (config-gated), or 'config:<path>'.

edges.description: Extra edges beyond the auto-derived one. Use the literal 'self' for this component's own node id.
